verdicts.reason: A uses the square well, with a large headline and a clear CTA. Its flaws: the bottle cap almost touches the top edge and spills out of its circle, which is crammed into the corner. The NEW pill is nearly as heavy as the Try It button, so the two compete. The buttons are right-aligned while the headline is left-aligned, so the layout has no common axis. B leaves the whole bottom half of the canvas empty, so the content sits in a cramped band at the top. In B the NEW pill and the Try It button differ in height and their tops don't line up, the stray decorative circle floats without purpose, and the bottle sits far off to the left, detached from the headline group.
